rules.logic: XQL(MP-006 NGFW Container Egress App-ID URL and DGA Signal) AND XQL(MP-006 Endpoint Container Process Network Causality) joined on the shared 5-tuple (source_ip, source_port, dest_ip, dest_port, protocol) plus container_id within a 10-second correlation window — asserts >= 2 distinct planes (CDR endpoint + NDR network) under one incident_id, producing the container-process -> outbound-session -> NGFW App-ID/URL/DGA causality chain.
rules.name: NGFW Container Egress to Endpoint Process Causality Stitch
